rows.note: Use this everyday word when the context makes clear that the fire pile is for burning a body; it is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.english: After the funeral, the body will be cremated on the pyre.
example.traditional: 葬禮之後，遺體會放上火堆火化。
example.jyutping: zong3 lai5 zi1 hau6 wai4 tai2 wui5 fong3 soeng6 fo2 deoi1 fo2 faa3

rows.note: Use this more explicit term when you need to identify the pile specifically as a funeral pyre rather than an ordinary fire pile.

example.english: Ancient texts record that the dead were burned on a funeral pyre.
example.traditional: 古籍記載，死者會放喺火葬堆上焚化。
example.jyutping: gu2 zik6 gei3 zoi3 sei2 ze2 wui5 fong3 hai2 fo2 zong3 deoi1 soeng6 fan4 faa3
